metadata.description: Retrieve a batch of properties for a specified object type within a given app.
metadata.learn_more: Retrieve a batch of properties for a specified object type within a given app. This endpoint is useful for fetching multiple properties efficiently in a single request, especially when dealing with large datasets or when specific properties are needed for processing.

appId.label: App Id
appId.description: The unique identifier of the app for which the properties are being retrieved.

objectType.label: Object Type
objectType.description: The type of object for which properties are being retrieved.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: A boolean indicating whether to include archived properties in the batch read. Defaults to false if not specified.

dataSensitivity.label: Data Sensitivity
dataSensitivity.description: A string representing the sensitivity level of the data being accessed. This property helps in determining the security measures needed for handling the data.

inputs.label: Inputs
inputs.description: An array of strings, each representing a property name to be included in the batch read operation.
